research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Accredited official statistics status
verified_claims: The Safety in Custody release is labelled accredited official statistics and was published on 30 April 2026.
limitations: Accreditation supports publication quality but does not make prison-estate statistics an exact-address or parcel safety score.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Release scope
verified_claims: The release covers deaths, self-harm and assaults in prison custody in England and Wales.
limitations: Custodial-estate outcomes describe a specialist institutional population, not neighbourhood or parcel conditions.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Deaths data cutoff
verified_claims: The publication updates deaths in prison custody through the end of March 2026.
limitations: The cutoff is national and temporal; it cannot be assigned to an individual land parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Assault and self-harm cutoff
verified_claims: Assault and self-harm statistics in the release run through the end of December 2025.
limitations: Different reporting cutoffs must not be merged as if they described one local reference date.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Publication cadence
verified_claims: Annual assault and self-harm tables are published with the December release, while provisional quarterly updates follow in July, October and January; deaths are reported three months ahead.
limitations: Cadence metadata supports freshness assessment only and is not a public-safety outcome.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Deaths in custody total
verified_claims: There were 352 deaths in prison custody in the 12 months to March 2026, 12% fewer than the 399 deaths in the previous 12 months.
limitations: This is a national custodial count and must not be interpreted as a parcel-level mortality risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Self-inflicted deaths
verified_claims: There were 67 self-inflicted deaths in the 12 months to March 2026, a 28% decrease from 93 in the previous 12 months.
limitations: Sensitive custodial mortality data require careful interpretation and do not measure community or property safety.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Latest-quarter deaths
verified_claims: The most recent quarter recorded 85 deaths, 9% fewer than the 93 deaths in the preceding quarter.
limitations: The bulletin warns that quarterly death figures are volatile and potentially seasonal.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Deaths per 1,000 prisoners
verified_claims: The death rate was 4.0 per 1,000 prisoners in the 12 months to March 2026, down from 4.6 in the previous 12 months.
limitations: A prison-population rate is not comparable to a residential parcel or general-population rate without a valid denominator and context.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Natural-cause deaths
verified_claims: There were 202 deaths from natural causes in the 12 months to March 2026, an 18% decrease from 246 in the previous period.
limitations: Cause classifications can be revised and remain unrelated to exact parcel safety.
